judged.what: The creator talks about good flash usage right as 100T Asuna gets eliminated following a flash, prompting him to hold his head and ask 'What? I was just talking about flashes just now!'
judged.reason: This is a routine single opening kill where Asuna dies early in the round. Despite the ironic timing with the creator's commentary, the play itself lacks the multi-kill or clutch quality needed for a hype highlight.
